cause: Training/serving skew on f3: the training pipeline applies a log1p transform (f3 = ln(1 + raw)) while the online serving path serves the raw, untransformed value. Verified on the Databricks SQL warehouse by joining training_sample and serving_log on entity_id over all 200 matched entities: f1, f2, f4, f5 match exactly (corr=1.0, zero diff), whereas f3 differs (corr=0.89). The relationship train.f3 = log1p(serve.f3) holds with max abs error 6e-7 (equivalently serve.f3 = expm1(train.f3)), so the serving path is missing the log1p feature transform.
